edit.description: Earlier robust response to large residuals, then baseline curvature; not a tolerance radius
edit.interpolation: smoothstep; phase is normalized over observed score nodes; no extrapolation
edit.normalization: dose is normalized over actual score nodes to a mean of one

failure_modes: The primary affinity metric does not improve relative to the tested incumbent M2, since the observed coordinate contrasts are associations and not evidence of affinity benefit.
The early-window robust curvature over-constrains the endpoint and degrades strain or structural validity even if coordinate control improves.
The observed non-monotone dx/dz profiles are batch-specific; in independent batches the early-large/late-small residual ordering is absent, so C1's timing no longer matches the data.
The dz late-window sign reversals (H003) mean full-window evaluation is required; scoring only endpoint values would misattribute the effect and mask a null result.
No accepted polynomial fit exists for any read feature, so any extrapolation of these profiles beyond the observed score window is unsupported and would invalidate the schedule rationale.
rationale: The Analyst handoff reports that the read landmark coordinates are non-monotone over the observed score window [0.0,0.49]: landmark_00_local_dx (H001) shows an early positive excursion, a mid-window negative trough and late recovery with a near-zero whole-window mean and no accepted polynomial; landmark_00_soft_mass (H002) instead carries a sustained positive whole-window level with a mid-window plateau; and the dz coordinates (H003) have near-zero whole-window means with opposing late-window rates. Because the residual structure is large early and relaxes toward baseline later, the registered curvature condition C1_robust_to_base (delta 0.5 -> 0.75 -> 1 over knots [0,0.5,1], dose fixed at 1, blend 0) is the offered temporal_recipe whose schedule matches this observed ordering: a more robust response to large residuals early, then baseline curvature. C2 (constant delta) and C3 (opposite timing) are not supported by the observed early-large/late-small residual pattern. This is a reward-route curvature change only; temperatures, teachers, dose and eta remain frozen, and the observed curves are associations, not measured guidance benefit.
